approved.en: Russian forces have intensified attacks on Ukrainian civilian infrastructure, striking a humanitarian hub, a hospital, a hospice and power plants, killing dozens and injuring many. Ukrainian drones are being used to evacuate wounded troops from the front, while Russia has deployed heavily-armed drones and launched its biggest mass attack on Ukraine's energy grid this year. The Oleshky ceasefire is being exploited by Russian troops to move forces, and a Russian Su‑57 fighter was lost to an engine fire at Akhtubinsk airfield. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russiske styrker har økt angrepene på ukrainsk sivil infrastruktur, og har truffet et humanitært knutepunkt, et sykehus, et hospice og kraftverk, og drept dusinvis og såret mange. Ukrainske droner brukes til å evakuere sårede soldater fra fronten, mens Russland har satt i drift tungt bearmede droner og igangsatt sitt største masseangrep mot Ukrainas energinett dette året. Oleshky-våpenhvilen utnyttes av russiske tropper for å flytte styrker, og en russisk Su‑57‑jager gikk tapt på grunn av en motorbrann på Akhtubinsk flyplass. Kamprelaterte dødsfall beløp seg til 75 767 i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Trump announced that US military aid to Israel will end by year-end, while the UN rights office warned that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare. Israeli soldiers clashed with Palestinians at the Gaza-Israel border and Israeli strikes killed at least four Palestinians in Gaza. Palestinian families returned to homes after an Israeli siege of Hebron and Palestinian Americans displayed US flags to protect West Bank homes from settler attacks. A West Bank school fortified its defences against settler violence. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske soldater kom i sammenstøt med palestinere ved grensen mellom Gaza og Israel, og israelske angrep drepte minst fire palestinere i Gaza. Palestinske familier flyttet tilbake til hjemmene etter en israelsk beleiring av Hebron, og palestinske amerikanere heiste USAs flagg for å beskytte hus i Vestbredden mot bosetternes angrep. approved.en: Israel has intensified artillery shelling of southern Lebanese towns, including a reported strike on a town and an explosion in Bani Hayyan, while Israeli drones have followed a woman entering a home in south Lebanon. Hezbollah has responded with artillery fire on Israeli positions and has begun distributing its first cash payments to war victims and displaced families. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon due to the fighting. These aid payments and the drone surveillance of civilians are new developments compared with the earlier brief on airstrikes and displacement.

Hizbollah har svart med artilleriskudd mot israelske posisjoner og har begynt å dele ut sine første kontantutbetalinger til krigsofre og fordrevne familier. FN rapporterer at 300 000 personer er fordrevne i Libanon på grunn av kampene. Disse hjelpetilskuddene og dronovervåkingen av sivile er nye utviklinger sammenlignet med den tidligere oppsummeringen av luftangrep og fordrivelse.

Israeli officials have called for new strikes on Iran while a missile hit a building in Tel Aviv. Yemen's government accused the IRGC and Hezbollah of sending 21 experts to support the Houthis in clashes near Taiz that left residents in panic. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Protests in Iraq have turned deadly, with four people killed and many wounded, while armed factions such as Kata'ib Hezbollah threaten to join a war if Iran is attacked and accuse the Iraqi prime minister and coordination framework of corruption in the PMF law. Iran has launched missile strikes in Iraq and Syria, prompting US condemnation and statements of readiness to assist Erbil, and Iran is developing a missile capable of reaching Europe. The Iraqi prime minister ordered increased power and fuel supplies to Kirkuk, and energy deals with Iran involving Iraq and Pakistan were signed as Tehran flexes Hormuz control. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iran har gjennomført missilangrep i Irak og Syria, noe som har ført til amerikansk fordømmelse og uttalelser om beredskap til å bistå Erbil, og Iran utvikler en missil som kan nå Europa. Iraks statsminister beordret økt strøm- og drivstoffforsyning til Kirkuk, og energikontrakter med Iran som involverer Irak og Pakistan ble signert mens Teheran viser sin kontroll over Hormuz. UCDP registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: RSF drones have intensified attacks on Sudan's power infrastructure in the east, causing widespread outages, while the Sudanese army shot down an FH-95 drone over West Kordofan. Sudan has lodged formal complaints against Ethiopia at the UN Security Council and the African Union over cross-border drone strikes. Displaced civilians returning to Khartoum and Darfur now face new challenges, including heightened famine risk in Kalma camp and survivors pledging to document killings after recent camp attacks. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Sudan har levert formelle klager mot Etiopia i FNs sikkerhetsråd og i Den afrikanske unionen over grenseoverskridende droneangrep. Sivilbefolkning som har flyktet tilbake til Khartoum og Darfur møter nå nye utfordringer, blant annet økt hungerrisiko i Kalma-leiren og overlevende som lover å dokumentere drap etter de siste leirangrepene. Konflikten førte til 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: A drone strike hit a location in South Sudan killing at least 153 people. In Ruweng, attackers killed 169 people including 79 soldiers. UNMISS condemned violence in Mayom County and Governor Madut called for calm after two people were killed in Aweil East. Police recruitment has sparked fears of a clampdown ahead of the first elections, while Uganda defended its military deployment in South Sudan and the government set conditions for Dr. Riek Machar’s return to Juba. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

UNMISS fordømte vold i Mayom fylke, og guvernør Madut oppfordret til ro etter at to personer ble drept i Aweil East. Rekruttering til politiet har vekket frykt for en nedslagning før de første valgene, mens Uganda forsvarte sin militære innsats i Sør-Sudan og regjeringen satte betingelser for Dr. Riek Machars tilbakekomst til Juba. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The WHO warns that the health system in northern Ethiopia is near collapse as attacks on civilians continue, including an RPG strike near a school in Moyale that killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers. Kenya has begun registering over 50,000 Ethiopian refugees fleeing the Moyale clashes. There were 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Kenya har begynt å registrere over 50 000 etiopiske flyktninger som flykter fra sammenstøtene i Moyale. Det var 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Uganda is accelerating its pullout of African Union peacekeeping troops from Somalia and Ethiopia is also planning to withdraw its forces as fighting intensifies. The United States and an East African nation have begun joint airstrikes against an al-Qaeda-linked group, while the UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year. Puntland mercenaries are fighting alongside Sudanese RSF forces and the Sudanese army reports northern Somali fighters supporting the RSF. Somali pirates seized an Iranian fishing vessel and rescued seven Pakistani crew members, and a Somali police officer was killed by an aircraft propeller, according to reports, and there were 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA og en østafrikansk nasjon har innledet felles luftangrep mot en al-Qaida-tilknyttet gruppe, mens De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte sitt første droneram mot al-Shabaab på nesten ett år. Puntland-leiesoldater kjemper sammen med RSF-militsen, og den sudanske hæren rapporterer om nordlige somaliske krigere som støtter RSF. Somaliske pirater tok kontroll over et iransk fiskefartøy og reddet syv pakistanske mannskap, og en somalisk politimann ble drept av en flypropell, ifølge rapporter, og det var 2 284 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Algerian forces have entered Niger to protect energy interests, adding a state actor to the Sahel insurgency. Armed terrorists are moving across the Kaduna River toward Shiroro in Niger State, extending the conflict’s geographic scope. Islamist militants continue abducting Islamic school students in Niger State, while bandits detonated dynamite while smuggling explosives to Burkina Faso, causing a deadly explosion. Journalists remain vulnerable, with twelve of thirteen killed since 2006 still lacking justice. The UCDP recorded 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Bevæpnede terrorister beveger seg over Kaduna-elven mot Shiroro i Niger-stat, og utvider konfliktens geografiske omfang. Islamistiske militante fortsetter å bortføre elever fra islamske skoler i Niger-stat, mens banditter detonerte dynamitt mens de smuglet sprengstoff til Burkina Faso, noe som forårsaket en dødelig eksplosjon. Journalister forblir sårbare, og tolv av tretten drept siden 2006 mangler fortsatt rettferdighet. UCDP registrerte 4 159 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen continue abducting civilians and attacking security forces across northern Nigeria, with recent incidents including the kidnapping of a university student in Plateau, the abduction of two visually impaired persons in Plateau, and the seizure of 14 schoolchildren from a farm. Security operatives have rescued multiple victims, such as eight abducted residents in Kaduna, a pregnant woman and seven others in Kaduna, and a group of 37 worshippers held for 212 days in Kaduna. Bandits have killed vigilantes, including a 18‑year-old in Plateau and a young woman in Bauchi, and police officers in a Sokoto-Zamfara highway ambush. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Sikkerhetsoperatører har reddet flere ofre, som åtte bortførte innbyggere i Kaduna, en gravid kvinne og syv andre i Kaduna, og en gruppe på 37 tilbedere holdt i 212 dager i Kaduna. Banditter har drept vigilante, inkludert en 18‑åring i Plateau og en ung kvinne i Bauchi, samt politifolk i et bakholdsangrep på motorveien mellom Sokoto og Zamfara. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Joseph Kabila now heads a rebel coalition that includes M23, which has taken positions in Rugezi after a week of fighting with Congolese government forces. The United States has imposed sanctions on Rwanda's defence ministry and its military bank Zigama for supplying the rebels and is moving to remove Rwanda and South Africa from the AGOA duty-free trade programme. An Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has killed more than 5,300 people, prompting WHO warnings of a continent-wide spread, while an anthrax outbreak in Africa’s oldest national park is killing hippos. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA har innført sanksjoner mot Rwandas forsvarsdepartement og den militære banken Zigama for å ha levert våpen til opprørerne, og vurderer å fjerne Rwanda og Sør-Afrika fra AGOA-programmet med tollfri handel. Et ebolautbrudd i Øst-DR Kongo har drept mer enn 5 300 personer, og WHO advarer om en spredning over hele kontinentet, mens et miltbruksutbrudd i Afrikas eldste nasjonalpark dreper flodhester. Konflikten forårsaket 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
